category_title: At-risk students in Applied courses with learned helplessness and inconsistent engagement
minimal_context: The student is reviewing a recent science test on energy resources and trying to connect the concepts to a geography lesson.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's review your science test on energy resources. Can you tell me how the power meter readings here connect to what we covered in geography class?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know. I learn geography in that room and I do science here. I learn science here and science here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to think about how they might be connected. What do you think?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I can't. Like I learn Math here and I do Math here. I don't see how there are connections amongst everything.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just look at the questions you missed on the science test and try again.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I failed the test because I'm stupid. I'm always going to fail, so there's no point in trying to figure this out.

task.content: relating concepts from like let's say one subject to another

context.materials: science test, power meter, examples of different energy resources

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: display learned helplessness with regard to their schoolwork
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: assume that he or she failed the test because he or she was stupid (internal and global) and will always fail (stable)

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: compartmentalized. Like I learn Math here and I do Math here. I learn science here and science here.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: They don't realise - it takes a lot for them to realise that there are connections amongst everything.
